security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown backticks, prose, safe temporary-file handling, or fixed argument-array subprocess calls. Confirmed risks include executing README-derived commands, loading files outside the skill directory, accessing a hidden home file, and dynamically importing external sibling code.

remediation.issue: A documented command extracted from an untrusted repository can execute with the agent process permissions.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact command and working directory, require immediate approval, and run it in a restricted container without secrets or host write access.

remediation.issue: The skill directs agents to load policies outside its package and consult a hidden file in the user home directory.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle required policies inside the skill, enforce skill-root path containment, and require explicit consent before reading user-specific files.

remediation.issue: The orchestrator dynamically imports and executes a sibling lessons module without verifying its integrity.
remediation.suggestion: Use a packaged dependency with a pinned integrity check, or remove dynamic loading and expose lesson recording through a trusted API.

content.value_statement: Deep learning repositories often lack a clear, trustworthy reproduction path. This skill selects a minimal documented target and records execution evidence and deviations.
actual_capabilities: Extracts documented commands and candidate targets from a repository README.
Prioritizes inference, evaluation, or short training verification before full training.
Plans environment, checkpoint, dataset, and cache requirements for the selected target.
Optionally executes the selected documented command with a configured timeout.
Produces standardized summaries, command records, logs, status, comparability notes, and README annotations.
Records assumptions, blockers, protocol deviations, patch evidence, and required human decisions.
limitations: It depends on companion RigorPilot skills and shared policy files that are not bundled here.
Repository documentation can be incomplete, outdated, or unsafe.
Full training requires explicit authorization and may exceed available compute or time.
Generated evidence does not prove scientific equivalence without researcher review.

use_cases.title: Verify a published repository
use_cases.description: Select and run the smallest documented inference or evaluation target, then record evidence and blockers.

use_cases.title: Audit reproducibility before review
use_cases.description: Compare repository guidance, observed behavior, and protocol deviations before assessing a research claim.

use_cases.title: Prepare a team handoff
use_cases.description: Create standardized reproduction outputs that preserve commands, assumptions, status, and next decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a minimal reproduction
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [repository path]. Select the smallest documented inference or evaluation target. Do not execute commands. Produce a reproduction plan with evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Run a documented smoke test
prompt_templates.prompt: Reproduce [repository path] using the smallest documented target. Show the selected command before execution. Stop after the first trustworthy result.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a partial reproduction
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [repository path] and [existing output path]. Identify blockers, assumptions, protocol deviations, and the lowest-risk next action. Preserve repository semantics.

prompt_templates.title: Assess training comparability
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether [repository path] can reproduce [paper result]. Verify dataset, split, checkpoint, preprocessing, metric, and training assumptions. Require approval before fuller training.

output_examples.input: Plan a minimal reproduction for an image-classification repository without running commands.
output_examples.output: Selected target: documented single-image inference. Evidence lists the README section, required checkpoint, setup assumptions, and the command awaiting approval.

output_examples.input: Run the smallest documented evaluation and explain why it failed.
output_examples.output: Outcome: blocked before evaluation because the checkpoint was absent. The report records the attempted command, error excerpt, asset requirement, and next safe action.

output_examples.input: Check whether a short training run supports the paper claim.
output_examples.output: Outcome: partial evidence only. Startup succeeded, but dataset split and metric settings remain unverified, so no comparability claim is made.

best_practices: Review every extracted command and its working directory before allowing execution.
Prefer the smallest documented target that can produce meaningful evidence.
Record every assumption, patch, and protocol deviation before comparing results.
anti_patterns: Do not run full training before environment, assets, and startup behavior are verified.
Do not change model semantics or metrics merely to obtain a successful result.
Do not treat generated reports as proof when key experimental details remain unverified.

faq.question: What repositories does this skill support?
faq.answer: It targets AI repositories with a README, scripts, configurations, and documented inference, evaluation, or training commands.

faq.question: Does it execute repository commands automatically?
faq.answer: Execution requires the run option. Review extracted commands because repository documentation is untrusted.

faq.question: Can it run full model training?
faq.answer: Yes, but fuller training requires explicit authorization after startup evidence is reviewed.

faq.question: What outputs does it create?
faq.answer: It creates summaries, command records, logs, status data, comparability notes, patch records, and an annotated README.

faq.question: Does it guarantee reproduction of published results?
faq.answer: No. It records evidence and deviations, but researchers must verify scientific comparability.

faq.question: Can it modify the target repository?
faq.answer: It prefers no edits. Necessary fixes should be conservative, isolated on a branch, verified, and documented.
